title: FiniteFreeLocalHomZero
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space, $\mathcal G$ a module sheaf [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], $x\in V\subseteq U\subseteq X$ with $U,V$ open, $I$ a finite set, and $A=\mathcal O_U^{\oplus I}$. Let $\psi:A|_V\to\mathcal G|_V$ be a module morphism [def-pur-localized-ringed-site]. Suppose for every $x\in Z\subseteq V$ and every $s\in A(Z)$ that the germ $\psi_Z(s)_x$ is zero [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]. Then there is an open $x\in W\subseteq V$ such that $\psi|_W=0$.

source.place: Tag 01CP, lemma-stalk-internal-hom, third paragraph; finite-coordinate construction and its finite-type vanishing argument.

proof.text: Apply the zero-germ criterion to the images of the restricted basis sections at V. Intersect the finitely many resulting neighborhoods with V.
Naturality makes every basis image zero on the intersection. Restriction preserves free coproducts, hence their universal property makes the restricted map zero. The empty basis uses V itself.

proof_origin.note: Categorical expansion of the finite-coordinate argument by R3; full proof in declaration docstring.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_finiteFree_local_hom_zero
    (X : RingedSpace.{u}) (G : Modules X) (x : X)
    (U V : Opens X) (hxV : x ∈ V) (i : V ⟶ U) (I : Type u) [Finite I]
    (ψ : (SheafOfModules.overMap ((sheafCompose (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj X.sheaf) i).obj
      (SheafOfModules.free (R := ((sheafCompose (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj X.sheaf).over U) I) ⟶ G.over V)
    (hψ : ∀ (W : Opens X) (j : W ⟶ V) (hxW : x ∈ W)
      (s : (SheafOfModules.free (R := ((sheafCompose (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj X.sheaf).over U) I).val.obj
        (op (Over.mk (j ≫ i)))),
      TopCat.Presheaf.germ G.val.presheaf W x hxW
        (ψ.val.app (op (Over.mk j)) s) = 0) :
    ∃ (W : Opens X) (hxW : x ∈ W) (j : W ⟶ V),
      (SheafOfModules.overMap ((sheafCompose (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj X.sheaf) j).map ψ = 0
